## Research Interests

My research focuses on quantitative approaches to understanding drug behavior and supporting development decisions. Areas of interest include:

- Quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) and physiologically based pharmacokinetics (PBPK)
- Population pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD) and Bayesian hierarchical modeling
- Integrating pharmacometrics with machine learning, including hybrid mechanistic and data-driven methods
- Reproducible scientific computing and model-informed drug development
